$schema_note: LUMI design tokens v1.5.0 (2026-08-07). Mirrors tokens/lumi-theme.css; usage in references/design-rules.md. Version lockstep: tokens carry the skill version. Repository language: English only (red line).

dark.note: applied only on explicit user request, via one body.dark override block — never a forked file

palette.note: one structure, two palettes; semantic meaning (accent = emphasis/pass, seal = warnings only) never changes with the palette

chart.note: CVD-validated triple; on dark canvas use the lifted forms from palette.dark

font.note: v1.2+: D-DIN is the single Latin face (titles ALL-CAPS weight 400, tight leading; CJK titles: weight 700 + 0.04em tracking, no uppercase). SIL OFL (Datto 2017), Latin-only; vendor and embed it — a declared face that never ships renders nothing. tabular-nums always on for data.

layout.verification_matrix: language x viewport (design / print / short-laptop); footer visible at every point
